summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins feature in the botocore repo. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derives from unittest.TestCase) with one test per behavioral criterion; keys are enum members because Enum hashes by member name.
